jobs.name: rot-kaya-s4101

settings.description: young woman with tan skin, dark brown hair in a high ponytail with a small red hair tie, fitted dark red jacket with thin ochre-gold piping only at the collar and front edge, red cloth waist sash, plain dark red hip panels and long plain dark red coat tails that hang as soft cloth with no gold hem, dark baggy trousers, dark brown leather calf boots with darker brown crossed straps, dark forearm bracers; the back of the jacket is plain dark red with no emblem

jobs.name: p1-kaya-diag

settings.description: Redraw as fine-grain pixel art: 1 px dark brown outline (#1b1410) only on silhouettes and deep overlaps, 3-5 flat tone groups per material, matte surfaces, no glossy highlights, no white glints, no bevels, warm key light from the upper left, cool brown shadows down-right, muted earth palette. One person stands on the paving. Keep the same person: same hair, face, costume, colours, facing and standing pose, same height. Render the person with the same painterly pixel texture, tone clusters, warm upper-left light and soft outline as the ground, so they belong to this scene. Raise the camera: draw the person as seen from higher above, a steep top-down three-quarter view matching the 2:1 isometric ground (about 45 degrees down), so more of the top of the head and the tops of the shoulders show, the torso is slightly foreshortened and both feet sit flat on the ground plane. Do not add anything else.

jobs.notes: world restyle + raised camera, background removed; the balance next read 314.2 before the restyles, 15 below this job's balance_after: unexplained, most likely this job billed as a 512 edit (25) though it reported 10
jobs.verdict: rejected: no steeper camera, rendering barely changed, outputs trimmed to the top-left
